description: Returns the year fraction representing the number of whole days between the start date and end date.

params.description: A serial date number that represents the start date.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A serial date number that represents the end date.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The type of day count basis to use: **0** or omitted - US (NASD) 30/360; **1** - Actual/actual; **2** - Actual/360; **3** - Actual/365; **4** - European 30/360.
params.name: arg3

signature: YEARFRAC(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
